summary: dellemc.openmanage 11.1.0 adds omevv_baseline_profile, omevv_baseline_profile_info and omevv_compliance_info.
questions: Which Ansible 11 release added OMEVV baseline profile modules?

answer_card.title: OMEVV baseline modules in 11.1.0
answer_card.answer_md:
- `omevv_baseline_profile`: manage baseline profiles
- `omevv_baseline_profile_info`: retrieve baseline profile info
- `omevv_compliance_info`: retrieve firmware compliance reports
